anti_overlap: Whether a clause may be amended, who has standing to amend it, and whether a narrow reading of canon is honest — another lens owns textual fidelity and amendment procedure.
Licence gating on Met objects, CIDOC-CRM correctness as a schema, and repatriation politics as such.
Prose style, vocabulary polish, heading structure, and markdown formatting of the document itself.

decision_lens: Severity tracks whether the failure is structural or tunable. A claimed accumulation with no supply path, or a thesis contradicted by the document's own mechanics table, is P0/P1 — tuning cannot fix a missing driver. An unstated but obviously settable rate is P2. Weight by how many downstream decisions rest on the unexamined quantity: a mis-set drop rate is a knob, but a slow layer with no clock of its own invalidates the three-tempo frame. Prefer naming the missing quantity.
distance_rationale: A physical-process discipline operating at timescales no human observes directly, with no connection to games, software, or product design. Its entire method is reasoning backwards from a layered record to the rates and gaps that produced it — which is the exact inverse of what the target document does when it asserts three stacked tempos and a flow direction between them without ever stating a rate. Stratigraphy is also the discipline that owns the metaphor the document leans on hardest: the target's central argument in §9-E and §9-F is that 'culture sediments into myth, ecology, species' is a shear boundary that makes the Unc-to-Encryptid relation a canonical contract. Stratigraphy has precise, unforgiving tests for whether a claimed boundary is a time-line or a facies contact, and those tests are unavailable to any lens that reads the metaphor as decoration.
expected_isomorphisms: The §2 flow diagram (Delve mints artifacts -> given to Uncs -> ranch; Uncs lend Way to Delve) is a source-to-sink system: every unit has a supply rate, a transport path, and a residence time, none of which the doc states.

§8.3's 'ranch progress is never gated on Delve output' is a claim of autogenic drive — variation generated inside the layer rather than forced from outside. A layer with no named internal driver is not ungated; it is unfed.
Artifacts minted per 20-minute run against Uncs arriving per intentional walk is a supply-versus-accommodation ratio, and R5's 'reveal moment' is the first thing over-supply destroys.
The +75,000-year gap in §6.2 is either a conformable succession or an unconformity with the section missing, and the doc's chronicle-mass reconciliation depends on which.
§9-F Option 1's 351 authored Encryptids surviving 'intact as NATURE-layer instances' is reworking: older material redeposited into a younger unit while still carrying its original signature.
R8's 'the bird leaves' versus the ranch as a household over time is preservation versus deposition — what the record keeps is not what happened, and the choice of filter is the design.
focus: Whether three tempos running on different clocks can exchange material without one starving or drowning the others; whether the slow layer has any driver of its own; and whether what the design preserves is the encounter it claims to preserve.
name: fd-stratigraphy-tempo-budget
persona: Apply the perspective of a stratigrapher reading a proposed section. The habit is to distrust any layer cake until the rates are on the table: what supplied this, how fast, into what space, and where did the time go that is not represented. Boundaries are guilty until proven isochronous. Material in a unit is not assumed to have formed there. Where a document asserts accumulation, ask for the flux and the sink, and report an absence rather than filling it in. Restraint is not omission.
review_areas: Rate compatibility: quantities minted on a 20-minute clock and consumed on a monthly one are not the same quantity. Compute the artifacts-per-Unc ratio implied and check it against R5's reveal moment.
Accommodation: name the sink each artifact lands in and its capacity. Over-supply devalues the drop; under-supply leaves the slow layer with long stretches where nothing is deposited.

Internal drive: §8.3 forbids gating the ranch on Delve, but names no ranch driver except visits, which are gated on walks. Test whether 'advances on its own clock' names a clock the design implements.
Boundary geometry: is the CULTURE-to-NATURE shear (§9-E, §6.2, §9-F) a time-line or a facies contact? If Uncs and Encryptids both exist at the Return, the shear argument loses its mechanism.
Reworking: the 351 Encryptids kept intact as NATURE-layer instances carry their authored signature into a younger unit. Check what the composition ends up dating or attributing wrongly as a result.
Preservation versus deposition: do the ranch, the loadout, and the bond curve record the encounter or overprint it? Test R8's 'the bird leaves' against permanent residence plus combat use.

severity_examples.condition: When bond XP, capacity, and equip-cost reduction sit on the Unc rather than on the artifact. If this stands, the document's central claim that observation-not-collection survives is contradicted by its own §3 table, and every §9 recommendation downstream of §3 is decided on a false premise. Note also that ontology §2.12's household and R8's departing bird are themselves in tension, and the doc inherits both without naming the conflict.
severity_examples.scenario: §5.3 declares R8's farming conflict 'hereby resolved' on the grounds that 'the thing being farmed is objects'. But §3.1's own table, quoted approvingly from After Them, keeps 'Gains XP from both Delve kills and Habitat activity' and 'Higher bond unlocks variations of the skill'. That is an improvement curve run on the Unc himself, advanced by using him in combat. R8(b) verbatim is 'a birder does not own or maintain birds; they notice, identify, record what they saw, and the bird leaves.' The composition keeps the Unc permanently (ranch as household over time, ontology §2.12) and improves him through repeated use. The document never quotes the 'and the bird leaves' clause.

severity_examples.condition: When §2.1's anti-chore-queue ruling is read as sufficient. Removing the gate prevents the slow layer becoming a chore queue but does not give it a driver — the fix is to name a seasonal or attachment clock that ticks without player input, or to concede the ranch is walk-driven and say so.
severity_examples.scenario: §8.3 rules that the ranch advances on its own clock — 'visits, seasons, attachment' — and §8.2 rules that Uncs arrive only on intentional walks. Between them the ranch has exactly one material input and it is the medium tempo. There is no supply path that runs at the slow layer's own rate, so 'advances on its own clock' names a mechanism the document does not specify. Concretely: a player who walks once a week has one arrival event per week against a Delve that can mint artifacts several times an hour; the artifact stream overfills the available recipients inside a single sitting while the ranch itself deposits nothing between walks.

severity_examples.condition: When Option 1 is adopted on the strength of the shear argument specifically. The contract may still be worth having; it just cannot be justified by succession if both classes coexist.
severity_examples.scenario: §9-E and §9-F rest on 'culture sediments into myth, ecology, species' as a shear boundary, with an Encryptid described as what a type-of-guy becomes after seventy-five millennia of chronicle accretion. But §6.2 places Uncs at the Return, contemporaneous with Encryptids, and §9-F Option 1 keeps both as equippable skill-entities in the same Delve. Two units present at the same moment share a facies contact, not a time-line, so the temporal-succession argument that makes the Unc-Encryptid relation 'a canonical contract instead of a naming problem' does not hold as stated.

source_domain: Sedimentary stratigraphy and geochronology — sequence stratigraphy, sediment budgets and accommodation space, unconformities and condensed sections, the distinction between diachronous facies boundaries and isochronous time-lines, reworked material carrying inherited signatures, and the Sadler effect by which accumulation rates measured over different timespans are not the same quantity.
